subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw make five global and per-agent memory role slots a supported core/plugin API now, with a defined upgrade migration and deprecation window for `plugins.slots.memory`?
rationale: This is a broad public configuration and plugin-hook contract; deciding its permanent shape, supported roles, per-agent semantics, and compatibility window requires maintainer product and ownership intent.

options.title: Sponsor a staged role-slot contract
options.body: Approve a narrower, documented role-slot API only after its migration and compatibility behavior are specified and proven on an upgrade path.

options.title: Keep the single core slot
options.body: Decline the new core config surface and require optional composition to remain within existing plugin seams until a smaller missing API is identified.

options.title: Request an RFC first
options.body: Pause this implementation while an owner-backed RFC settles role ownership, hook semantics, and per-agent behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a staged role-slot contract
recommendation.body: Approve a narrower, documented role-slot API only after its migration and compatibility behavior are specified and proven on an upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routes the PR to steipete, and the unresolved choice is a core product/API direction rather than a mechanical code repair.
